text:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Cygnus Analytics pilot tomorrow. They want traffic pinned to sa-east + eu-west and a short rate window. Renewal convo hinging on a smooth demo.
Ethan (AM): Demo ramp 09:00-11:00 BRT. Expect burst ~3k req/min across both regions. Source IPs to exempt: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/28. Must preserve x-customer-id header on retries.
Liam (SRE): We can set region routing + IP ACL. Need confirmed qps per region and security sign-off for IP exceptions.
Maya (CS): Customer asked for +500 qps per region (soft window to 600 qps) on /v1/generate, window 72h, auto-revoke. Target p95 <50ms during demo.
Sofia (Eng-Infra): Draft policy bundle (apply to staging then prod):
```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "regions": ["sa-east-1","eu-west-1"],
  "rate_policy": {"qps":600, "window_hours":72, "auto_revoke":true},
  "ip_exceptions": ["198.51.100.0/24", "203.0.113.0/28"],
  "preserve_headers": ["x-customer-id"]
}
```
Sofia (Eng-Infra): I'll run `infractl apply --bundle cygnus-pilot-3320001234 --env staging` and smoke-test, then promote to prod if green.
Ben (Platform): Applied to staging. Smoke results: p95=42ms. Requesting prod promote window at 08:30 UTC.
Maya (CS): Sending curl test to customer to validate routing:
```
curl -H "x-customer-id: cygnus-pilot" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```
Liam (SRE): Alerting wired: `alert: cygnus-pilot-rate-window; condition: error_rate>2% || p95>120ms`. Created INC-332000 for audit and rollback playbook.
ops-bot: Change queued -> INC-332000; staging->prod promote scheduled 08:30 UTC.
Ben (Platform): Promoted to prod at 08:32 UTC. Policy active in sa-east-1 and eu-west-1. Auto-revoke set for 72h.
Maya (CS): Customer confirmed demo went well. They reported occasional header strip on retries — logged feedback with Eng.
Liam (SRE): Renewal lead updated; CS flags low risk. We'll monitor telemetry for 48h for regressions. :thumbsup:
